name: Arklow Golf Links
note: Par 70 men / 72 ladies. The club publishes its scorecard only as an image (/wp-content/uploads/sites/7570/2019/06/Folded-Score-Card-2018-FINAL-Print-2.jpg), which the research tools cannot read. Aggregators agree on the par hole-by-hole but their stroke-index columns disagree on most holes (golfsherpa vs 18birdies), so no trustworthy stroke index could be transcribed without picking a winner. Lands cardless; the first scorecard photo settles the card. No USGA course rating or slope published either.
